summary: AI Engineer at TCS building Generative AI, RAG, LLM fine-tuning, and AI-agent systems with open-source LLMs (Llama), LangChain/LangGraph, vector databases, and FastAPI. Deployed a RAG chatbot for a public-sector bank client; fine-tunes small language models with LoRA/QLoRA and builds evaluation-driven pipelines covering retrieval quality, hallucination detection, and leakage-controlled benchmarks. Also ships in-browser AI: this portfolio runs a real language model in the visitor's browser — no server, no API keys.
skills: LLMs & fine-tuning (Llama 3.1/3.2, SLMs, LoRA/QLoRA, Unsloth, TRL, GGUF, llama.cpp, Ollama)
RAG & retrieval (ChromaDB, Sentence Transformers, BGE, semantic search, citation-grounded generation)
AI agents (LangChain, LangGraph, tool calling, self-correction loops, text-to-SQL)
LLM evaluation & safety (RAGAS, NDCG, execution accuracy, hallucination detection, leakage control, STRIDE threat modeling)
Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, REST APIs, Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions, pytest
In-browser LLM inference (WebLLM, wllama, MiniLM embeddings)

experience.detail: Built and deployed a client-facing RAG chatbot enabling branch staff of a public-sector bank to resolve recurring transaction issues — interest-rate errors and data-correction requests — in real time. Architected the pipeline on LangChain, Llama 3.1 8B (Ollama), BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embeddings, and Oracle Database as the vector store. Designed the AI-assisted resolution workflow that lets branches resolve 75% of identified service-desk requests without backend-analyst escalation.

Built an in-browser RAG assistant: build-time MiniLM embeddings, cosine top-k retrieval, a retrieval-score router between grounded and general-AI modes, and WebLLM streaming with a WASM fallback ladder — all client-side, eval-tested. This portfolio is itself the demo.

education.school: Annasaheb Dange College of Engineering and Technology, Ashta

certification: Generative AI with Large Language Models
